# CANDIDATE: VWAP_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER_VWAP_RECLAIM_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that VWAP anchored entry patterns (reclaim or rejection of the prior day's VWAP) during overnight hours provide a persistent edge in SPY 0DTE options. This edge may arise from institutional order flow that leans on VWAP as a fair value reference, creating mean-reverting or continuation tendencies that can be captured with defined entry/exit rules.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when the first 5-minute bar after 04:00 ET either reclaims (closes above) or rejects (closes below) the prior day's VWAP level, with additional filters: volume multiplier >= 1.5x, proximity to VWAP within $0.15, minimum bar body >= $0.05, and lookback of 2 bars for confirmation. Exit uses a fixed premium stop of -14%, TP1 at +50% of premium (selling 2/3 of qty), runner target at +200% of premium, and a profit-lock that arms at +10% premium and trails with a 5% offset. The combo also requires EMA ribbon agreement (fast < pivot < slow) and a minimum ribbon spread of 30 cents.
